details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3 and K5 are fully represented with the headline financials, Big 3 contribution, ad-revenue optimisation and liquidity metrics. K4 (2026 guidance) and K6 (framework-driven development strategy) are entirely absent.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Each sentence builds logically on the previous ones: revenue and profitability growth (S2–S5) are explained by the performance of the Big 3 titles (S6–S10), the decline in legacy titles (S11), and the shift to in-app advertising (S12–S14). Cost increases (S15) are presented as a direct consequence of portfolio scaling. The balance-sheet and liquidity statements (S16–S19) follow naturally from the operational narrative and contain no contradictions. No repetition or organizational gaps are present.
